# Washington Secretary of State

> The Washington Secretary of State office serves as the state's chief election official, business filing authority, and custodian of public records, led by Secretary Steve Hobbs.

This site provides essential services for business registration, nonprofit filings, elections administration, and public records access across Washington State. The office maintains multiple service locations including headquarters in Olympia and regional offices in Tumwater and Cheney.

## Key Topics

- Business Entity Filings
- Nonprofit & Charity Registration
- Secretary of State Steve Hobbs
- Public Records Requests
- Apostille Services
- Trademark Registration
- Service of Process
- Domestic Partnerships
- Elections Administration
- Washington State Government
- Filing Requirements
- Office Locations
- Corporations & Charities Division
- State Archives
- Address Confidentiality Program

## Business Filings & Corporations

- [Corporations & Charities](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities): Main portal for business and nonprofit filings through Corporations & Charities Filing System
- [Filings, Forms & Information](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/business-entities/filings-forms-information): Business entity filing forms, instructions, and online filing information
- [Download Forms & Online Filing Instructions](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/business-entities/download-forms-online-filing-instructions): Downloadable business entity forms and online filing instructions
- [Trademarks](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/additional-services/trademarks): Washington state trademark registration, search, and filing requirements
- [Service of Process/Summons and Complaint](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/additional-services/service-processsummons-and-complaint): Information on service of process filing and registered agent services
- [Apostilles Services & Information](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/apostilles-services-information-resource-page): Guide to apostille document authentication services under Hague Convention

## Nonprofit & Charity Services

- [Nonprofit & Charity Resources](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/nonprofits-charities/nonprofit-charity-resources): Directory of nonprofit support organizations and capacity-building resources
- [Domestic Partnerships](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/additional-services/domestic-partnerships): Domestic partnership registration forms and legal requirements under RCW 26.60

## Office Information & Leadership

- [Home](https://www.sos.wa.gov): WA Secretary of State homepage with links to business filings, elections, and public records
- [About the Office](https://www.sos.wa.gov/about-office): Overview of Office of Secretary of State mission, divisions, and public services
- [Secretary of State Steve Hobbs](https://www.sos.wa.gov/about-office/secretary-state-steve-hobbs): Biography of Washington Secretary of State Steve Hobbs and office leadership
- [News](https://www.sos.wa.gov/about-office/news): Government announcements and news from WA Secretary of State office

## Public Records & Access

- [Public Records Request](https://www.sos.wa.gov/about-office/public-records-request): Guide to requesting public records under Washington Public Records Act

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Us - Main Office](https://www.sos.wa.gov/about-office/contact-us): Contact information, office locations, and services for WA Secretary of State
- [Contact Us - Corporations & Charities](https://www.sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities/contact-us): Contact information and office locations for Corporations & Charities Division
- [Employment](https://www.sos.wa.gov/employment): Employment opportunities and career information at WA Secretary of State
- [Invite Secretary of State to an Event](https://www.sos.wa.gov/invite-secretary-state-event): Form and process to request Secretary Hobbs as speaker at events
